meta.legalNote: The fourteen categories are the ones Annex II of Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 makes compulsory. In Germany, the LMIDV of 5 July 2017 lets a counter give that information in writing, electronically or out loud, but only if a written record exists and can be seen on request.

allergens.say: Ich vertrage kein Gluten. Ist da Weizen, Roggen, Gerste oder Hafer drin?
allergens.sayEn: I cannot tolerate gluten. Does this contain wheat, rye, barley or oats?
allergens.note: The only two phrases with a legal meaning are glutenfrei, at most 20 mg/kg, and sehr geringer Glutengehalt, at most 100 mg/kg.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Krebstiere. Sind Garnelen oder Krebs darin?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to crustaceans. Are there prawns or crab in this?
allergens.note: Rare in German food, common in the Vietnamese and Thai kitchens that Berlin is full of.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Ei. Ist Ei darin, auch in der Soße?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to egg. Is there egg in it, including in the sauce?
allergens.note: Egg hides in mayonnaise, remoulade and every breadcrumb coating, not only in obvious egg dishes.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Fisch. Ist Fisch oder Sardelle darin?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to fish. Is there fish or anchovy in this?
allergens.note: Anchovy sits inside classic German sauces, and fish sauce sits inside most Vietnamese broths.

allergens.say: Ich habe eine Erdnussallergie. Sind Erdnüsse darin?
allergens.sayEn: I have a peanut allergy. Are there peanuts in this?
allergens.note: Legally a separate category from tree nuts, so ask about both if you react to both.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Soja. Ist Soja darin?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to soy. Is there soy in this?
allergens.note: Soy flour is a normal bakery improver, so a plain German bread roll is not automatically soy free.

allergens.say: Ich vertrage keine Milch. Ist Milch, Butter oder Sahne darin?
allergens.sayEn: I cannot tolerate milk. Is there milk, butter or cream in it?
allergens.note: Say Milch rather than laktosefrei if this is an allergy. Lactose free is a different thing and still contains milk protein.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Nüsse. Sind Nüsse oder Marzipan darin?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to tree nuts. Are there nuts or marzipan in this?
allergens.note: German cake counters run on hazelnut and almond, and marzipan is an almond product.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Sellerie. Ist Sellerie in der Brühe oder im Gewürz?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to celery. Is there celery in the stock or in the seasoning?
allergens.note: The single most underestimated one in Germany. Suppengrün and most stock powders contain celeriac.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Senf. Ist Senf darin, auch in der Soße?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to mustard. Is there mustard in it, including in the sauce?
allergens.note: Mustard is inside sausage meat, remoulade, potato salad and most dressings, not only the yellow blob on the plate.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Sesam. Ist Sesam darin?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to sesame. Is there sesame in this?
allergens.note: Bread rolls, flatbread and every tahini based sauce. Sesame also travels between trays at a bakery counter.

allergens.say: Ich reagiere auf Sulfite. Sind Sulfite darin?
allergens.sayEn: I react to sulphites. Are there sulphites in this?
allergens.note: Declared above 10 mg/kg. Wine, dried fruit and many pickled things sit above that line.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Lupine. Ist Lupinenmehl darin?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to lupin. Is there lupin flour in this?
allergens.note: Uncommon but real in German baking and in vegan protein products.

allergens.say: Ich bin allergisch gegen Weichtiere. Sind Muscheln oder Tintenfisch darin?
allergens.sayEn: I am allergic to molluscs. Are there mussels or squid in this?
allergens.note: Mostly a question for the Asian and Mediterranean kitchens rather than for German food.
